ios.desc:
Personalize your entire iPhone in one app. Wallpapers, a custom Dynamic Island, home screen widgets, photo widgets, and app icons — everything you need to make your screen truly yours.

LIVE & 3D WALLPAPERS
Thousands of HD wallpapers and 3D live backgrounds, with new ones added every week. Browse by category — Nature, Anime, Neon, AMOLED, Cars, Space, Abstract, Sports and more — then set them on your Lock Screen or Home Screen. Parallax wallpapers add real depth that shifts as you move your phone.

DYNAMIC ISLAND & NOTCH
Give your Dynamic Island a whole new personality. Pick from a stylish collection of designs, or open the editor to add stickers, emojis and custom art around the island and notch for a one-of-a-kind look no one else has.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Smart widgets, your way. Add customizable widgets for the things that matter — clock, date, weather, battery and more — and match them to your wallpaper for a clean, coordinated home screen.

PHOTO WIDGETS
Keep the people you love in view. Turn your favorite photos into beautiful photo widgets with custom frames, fonts and layouts, right on your Home Screen.

CUSTOM APP ICONS
Finish the look with exclusive app icon packs. Swap your everyday icons for a matching aesthetic and give your whole home screen a coordinated theme.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Thousands of 4K & HD wallpapers, updated weekly
• Live, 3D and parallax backgrounds
• Custom Dynamic Island & notch designs
• Home screen widgets & photo widgets
• Exclusive app icon themes
• Simple to use — set anything in a couple of taps
• Save your favorites for quick access

Whether you want a cute aesthetic, a bold neon look, a clean minimal theme or something totally unique, everything you need to personalize your iPhone is right here.

SUBSCRIPTION
The app is free to download and use. Some premium features and content are available through a subscription (weekly) or a one-time purchase as an in-app purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
